title: Sirloin Steak Stir Fry with Filipino Citrus
description: A quick and delicious sirloin steak stir fry with a hint of Filipino citrus flavors.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sirloin steak and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Remove steak from the wok and let it rest for 5 minutes.
In the same wok, add onion and bell pepper and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in calamansi juice, salt, and black pepper.
Return the sirloin steak to the wok and stir to coat with the citrus sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the steak is well coated.
Slice the steak against the grain and serve with the stir-fried vegetables.
Garnish with fresh chilies and serve immediately.
